question: Should Workspaces permanently expose a separate persisted `builtin:preview` kind, or should reload and viewport controls extend the existing `builtin:iframe-embed` capability?
rationale: Phase one duplicates the existing embed security and rendering path, while a distinct kind becomes a long-lived document contract; future process, console, and screenshot capabilities are proposed but are not implemented here.

options.title: Extend iframe embed
options.body: Add optional reload and viewport chrome to the existing embed renderer so URL policy, bindings, sandboxing, tests, and future maintenance stay canonical.

options.title: Approve a distinct preview kind
options.body: Accept the additional persisted contract for future privileged preview phases, then require the binding, state, localization, and proof blockers to be fixed before merge.

options.title: Pause this phase
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open until the future dev-server or browser-backed capabilities provide enough product distinction to justify a separate builtin.

recommendation.title: Extend iframe embed
recommendation.body: Add optional reload and viewport chrome to the existing embed renderer so URL policy, bindings, sandboxing, tests, and future maintenance stay canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed Workspaces roadmap and implementation history and can prepare either repair shape, although a repository maintainer must provide the final product sponsorship.
